ground_truth.description: The docstring describes a historical, pre-WP-B failure mode and cites the 2026-04-17 reify incident, but the diff rewrites 'add_task' to 'submit_task' in that historical narrative. submit_task/resolve_ticket did not exist before the migration, so the past-incident rationale is now anachronistic and factually inaccurate; the historical tool name should be preserved.

submit_task and resolve_ticket are added to DISALLOW_TASK_WRITES, which the tests assert must block them only in Stage 1/3 while Stage 2 remains able to create tasks. If any stage composition path applies DISALLOW_TASK_WRITES to Stage 2 (which the migrated stage2 prompt now instructs to call submit_task+resolve_ticket), Stage 2 task creation would be silently blocked and fail — a plausible cause of the observed escalation_created event. Verify Stage 2 explicitly re-enables these two tools.

The prompt enumerates only status values created/combined/failed for resolve_ticket, and describes it as blocking until the curator decides. It gives no guidance for a resolve_ticket that never returns / times out beyond 'do not retry silently', and does not cover any other terminal status (e.g. rejected/duplicate), leaving the agent's behavior undefined on unexpected outcomes.

task.title: Migrate reconciliation add_task callers to submit_task + resolve_ticket
task.description:
Migrate reconciliation-stage code and prompts that invoke the deprecated add_task MCP tool to the new submit_task + resolve_ticket flow introduced in task 919.

Scope (reconciliation subtree):
- fused-memory/src/fused_memory/reconciliation/prompts/stage2.py — Stage-2 prompt lists add_task in the tool menu; replace with submit_task + resolve_ticket and update usage guidance.
- fused-memory/src/fused_memory/reconciliation/prompts/__init__.py — base prompt tool enumeration string.
- fused-memory/src/fused_memory/reconciliation/cli_stage_runner.py — DISALLOW_TASK_WRITES list currently lists `mcp__fused-memory__add_task`; update to also disallow `mcp__fused-memory__submit_task` for the same read-only stages (and ensure resolve_ticket is allowed only where add_task was previously allowed).
- fused-memory/src/fused_memory/reconciliation/event_queue.py — docstring references add_task; update to reflect new tool surface.

For each call site:
- Where reconciliation agents create tasks: replace add_task with submit_task + resolve_ticket (short-budget) pattern inside the prompt text, including handling of status="dropped" / "combined".
- Where add_task appears in disallow/allow lists: update accordingly.

Out of scope: orchestrator code, skill prompts, facade removal.

Depends on: 919.
